description: SALTLoad: Distribution Substation Electrical Load Dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Sazidul Islam Sazid, Hasanur Rahman (International University of Business Agriculture and Technology). This repository contains SALTLoad, a high-resolution multi-feeder electrical load dataset collected from a distribution substation operated by the Saltha Palli Bidyut Samity in Faridpur, Bangladesh. Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
